text: This report recommends approval of travel expenses for Jason White, Occupational Health and Safety Consultant to attend the American Industrial Hygiene Conference and Exposition (AIHce) 2023.

The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Authorized travel expenses for Jason White, Occupational Health and Safety Consultant to attend the American Industrial Hygiene Conference and Expo 2023 (AIHce) in Phoenix, Arizona from May 21, 2023 to May 25, 2023, at a cost not expected to exceed $4,000 plus HST for flights, accommodation, and incidental expenses.
